description.zh: 随 Mosael 发布的 ComfyUI 工作流范例。先检查每张缺哪些节点和模型，再选择要安装的那几张；只新建、不覆盖。
description.en: ComfyUI workflow examples bundled with Mosael. Check every workflow's missing nodes and models first, then choose which ones to install; files are created, never overwritten.

description.zh: 「任意长度的连续视频」的第一段：从文字生成开场，并把第一段潜空间存下来。
description.en: The opening segment of “Continuous video of any length”: generate from text and save the first latent.

description.zh: 读取上一段潜空间继续拍，保存当前段潜空间；和第一段配套使用。
description.en: Continue from the previous latent and save the current one; use it with the opening workflow.

name.zh: H3 数字人 · 第一段

description.zh: 「任意时长的数字人」的第一段：人物照片和驱动音频生成开场，并保存潜空间。
description.en: The opening segment of the digital-human long video: portrait plus driving audio, saving the first latent.

description.zh: 读取上一段数字人潜空间继续说话，保存当前段潜空间；和第一段配套使用。
description.en: Continue the digital human from the previous latent and save the current one; use it with the opening workflow.

name.en: MiniMax H3 Image · text to image

description.zh: 用 MiniMax H3 Image 出静图:默认 16MP、6 步、CFG 1,并先用 Qwen3.5-9B 把短提示词扩成完整画面描述;可下拉关掉扩写或改画幅。
description.en: Draws stills with MiniMax H3 Image: 16 MP by default, 6 steps, CFG 1, and a Qwen3.5-9B prompt enhancer that expands the short prompt first; turn it off or change the canvas from the dropdowns.

name.zh: FLUX.3 关键帧 · 白模机位 + 人物 + 场景
name.en: FLUX.3 keyframe · blockout camera + character + scene

description.zh: 第一张必须是这一镜的灰色白模:机位、构图、人站在哪照它来,画出来是成片质感、不留灰色人偶;后面两张可选,是人物三视图和场景设定图,管长相服装和陈设。「从主题到完整视频」逐镜画首尾帧推荐用它。
description.en: The first image must be the shot's grey blockout: camera, framing and staging follow it while the picture comes out finished, with no grey mannequins left. The next two are optional, a character turnaround and a location concept image for looks, outfit and set. The recommended keyframe model for “Topic to finished video”.

name.zh: FLUX.3 关键帧 · 人物三视图 + 场景图

description.zh: 整张人物三视图和一张场景设定图一起参考,按文字画这个人在这个地方的一帧:长相服装、场景陈设都跟着参考图,景别、机位、动作跟着文字。手里没有白模、只想按文字定机位时用它。
description.en: References a whole character turnaround and a location concept image at once, and draws that person in that place as the text describes: looks, outfit and set follow the references, shot size, camera and action follow the text. Use it when there is no blockout and the text sets the camera.

name.zh: MOSS-Image 关键帧 · 人物三视图 + 场景图

description.zh: 同样的两张参考图交给 MOSS-Image 编辑 LoRA:只画一个人、机位跟得上文字;实测人物服装和场景的贴合不如 FLUX.3 那张,商用许可更宽(Apache 2.0)。
description.en: The same two references through the MOSS-Image edit LoRA: one person, camera follows the text; measured looks and set fidelity are below the FLUX.3 one, with a more permissive licence (Apache 2.0).
